lines.1: For the moment, we followed Fukahire to the school gate.
lines.2: 「We wait here for first-years. If a cute one comes by, I'll talk to her.」
lines.3: 「Then I'll reel her in and take her to the student council room. Simple, but effective. Right?」
lines.4: 「Except for the part where it's impossible.」
lines.5: 「If we're going with a pickup plan, we should use handsome Subaru.」
lines.6: 「No. You're used to him, Crab, but someone seeing Subaru for the first time is extremely likely to be scared.」
lines.7: 「Leo isn't the type to chatter away with a stranger. In other words, this is a job for me.」
lines.8: 「...If you're that sure, go ahead and try.」
lines.9: 「Leave it to me. I'll show you how cool I can be.」
lines.10: 「(Subaru's popular with girls, and I can't let my guard down around Leo either.)」
lines.11: 「(I'm making her my girl. It'd be a problem if she fell for one of them first.)」
lines.12: 「(Love is war. Nothing wrong with getting a head start.)」
lines.13: 「Oh! Here comes one already. How about her?」
lines.15: 「What? She's a five? She doesn't look that bad.」
lines.16: 「The Princess is around five hundred and thirty thousand, so I need at least forty thousand.」
lines.17: 「You sure talk big for someone so ugly.」
lines.20: 「Nice, thick thighs. But her lips are too full, so pass.」
lines.21: 「What about the one coming after her?」
lines.25: They were a fairly cute pair.
lines.26: He was choosing entirely according to his own taste.
lines.27: 「Hey, can I talk to you two for a moment?」
lines.30: 「I am interested in the student council president.」
lines.31: 「I see. Well, the president wants to work with cute girls like you.」
lines.33: 「So, would you like to join the student council?」
lines.34: 「A-are you a member of the student council too?」
lines.36: 「I'm a shark, but I won't eat you.」
lines.37: 「And I don't mean 'eat' in a dirty way.」
lines.38: 「This is bad. He's going off the rails.」
lines.39: 「How does he always manage to sabotage himself?」
